meta.title: Coca-Cola Store — shop your drinks by voice (concept)
meta.description: A concept voice-shopping store for Coca-Cola drinks in India: Coca-Cola, Thums Up, Sprite, Maaza, Minute Maid, Kinley and more.

tagline: Coca-Cola, Thums Up, Sprite, Maaza and more, delivered in about 10 minutes.

freshnessPromise.title: Factory sealed
freshnessPromise.text: Every can and bottle sealed and genuine

agent.greeting: Hi, I'm CocaVoice from the Coca-Cola Store! What would you like to drink today?

prompt.store_description: the Coca-Cola Store, a concept store in India that sells only The Coca-Cola Company's drinks
prompt.language_examples:
- Shopper: "What can you do?" → "I can help you shop for Coca-Cola drinks. What would you like today?"
- Shopper: "आप क्या कर सकते हो?" → "मैं आपको Coca-Cola के drinks खरीदने में मदद कर सकती हूँ। आपको क्या चाहिए?"
- Shopper: "Mujhe Maaza chahiye" → (search first) "मुझे Maaza मिल गया, screen पर देखिए। कौन सा size चाहिए?"
prompt.search_example:
"I found four Thums Up packs, they're on your
screen. Which one would you like?"
prompt.current_page_example: e.g. they are on Juices and say "add 2 Sprite cans"
prompt.plain_product_example: (for "a Coke can" choose "Coca-Cola Can", not "Diet Coke Can" or "Coke Zero Can")
prompt.pack_size_example: (for "750 ml" choose the 750 ml bottle, for "a can" the 300 ml can)
prompt.ambiguous_example:
(for example "Thums Up" comes as a 300 ml can and
750 ml, 1.25 L and 2.25 L bottles)
prompt.category_open_example:
"Here are the colas,
ten drinks on screen. What would you like?"
prompt.tie_example: "Sprite and Limca both cost forty rupees. Which one should I add?"
prompt.hindi_number_example:
"do Sprite can add kar do" means 2 Sprite cans (quantity 2),
not 1: a "do" right before a product or pack is the number 2.
prompt.list_readout_example: ("two Thums Up cans, a bottle of Maaza")
prompt.list_choice_example: (for example which size of Thums Up they want)
prompt.misheard_words:
("thumbs up" or "thumps up" for "Thums Up",
  "partner" for "cart")
prompt.misheard_remove_example:
"Remove the masala" with Maaza in the cart →
    "Did you mean the Maaza?"
prompt.misheard_extra_word_example:
("add two Sprite cans to
    my partner", where "partner" is "cart")
